title: Latency report (lowlat-report/1)
description: One report per run of one example variant. Latencies are integer nanoseconds, summarised by percentiles and a cross-decodable HdrHistogram; a latency mean is deliberately impossible (percentiles forbids extra properties). The optional 'model' object is the ONLY place a time-average may appear, as a labelled input to Little's Law / Amdahl's Law model checks (Ch2); it is never a latency result.

language.description: Implementation language of the measured program.

variant.description: Variant within the example, e.g. 'naive' or 'preallocated'.

unit.description: Unit of every latency value in this report.

count.description: Number of latency samples recorded in the histogram.

dropped.description: Parcels lost, counted as gaps in the sequence numbers.

percentiles.description: Latency percentiles in ns, measured from intended emit time. No other keys are allowed, so no mean can be added.

hdr_histogram.description: HdrHistogram in the compressed V2 form, base64 encoded; decodable by the C, Java and Python implementations.

build.description: How the measured program was built and run.

compiler.description: Compiler or runtime name and version, e.g. 'g++ 16.1.1', 'CPython 3.14.8', 'OpenJDK 25'.

flags.description: Build flags or runtime options, when relevant.

gil_enabled.description: Python only: whether the GIL is enabled (false on a free-threaded build). null for C++ and Java.

profile.description: Machine profile captured by scripts/profile.sh. That script owns the shape; only the schema identifier is checked here.

model.description: Optional modelling inputs for Little's Law / Amdahl's Law checks (Ch2). The only place a time-average (for example a mean residence time W) may appear. Free-form.

runtime.description: Optional managed-runtime and scheduler facts for the run (additive; reports without it stay valid). Like the percentiles, it can never carry a mean: no key anywhere inside it may be named 'mean' or end in '_mean' or 'mean_ns'.

heap_bytes.description: Configured or observed heap size in bytes.

old_gen_used_bytes.description: Old-generation bytes in use after a collection at the end of the run (what the collector must carry; off-heap state does not count).

alloc_bytes_per_parcel.description: Bytes allocated per parcel on the measured path.

jit.description: Free-form JIT counts (for example compilations, deoptimizations), keyed by measurement window.

used.description: Whether the cache was actually used.

ctx_switches.description: Context switches of the measured thread or process.

alloc_stalls.description: Allocation stalls (jdk.ZAllocationStall) during the run: the mutator waited for the collector to free memory.

noMean.description: No-mean rule: no property name in this subtree names a mean or an average, matched case-insensitively: mean, avg or average as a whole word or snake_case/kebab-case/dotted part (mean, mean_ns, pause_mean_ns, mean_compile_ns, avg, avg_ns, average_ns), as a camelCase part (meanNs, avgNs, pauseMeanNs), or as a trailing meanns/avgns.
